Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. The umpires and the players have made their way out in the middle. Beth Mooney and Ellyse Perry are the openers for Australia Women. Nonkululeko Mlaba comes to bowl. Here we go...
... The Run Chase ...

Right then, South Africa Women have posted a total of 124 runs. Their bowlers will have to come up with something special to stop the mighty Aussies. Can they do it? Let's find out together. Chase coming up shortly...

Australia Women will be pleased with their bowling performance. They were a bit sloppy at the start and missed some chances but they recovered well. They used seven bowlers throughout their innings and everyone was economical. Georgia Wareham picked two wickets whilst Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown, Ashleigh Gardner, and Ellyse Perry chipped one wicket each.

South Africa Women were off to a steady start. Both the openers looked good but lost their first wicket on 54 runs. Once the opening stand was broken, wickets kept on tumbling for them at regular intervals. Tazmin Brits scored 45 runs and was the only standout batter in their team. South Africa Women will be certainly disappointed with their effort as they have just managed to post a par total of 124 runs on the board.
A single to end the innings. A bit short, on off. Nadine de Klerk stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single. South Africa Women end their innings at 124/6.
This is worked to square leg for a single.
Sinalo Jafta walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Sune Luus cannot applying the finising touches here. It is fuller, around middle and leg. Sune Luus dances down the track, tries to heave it away but misses. She sees the ball sneak under the blade and disturb the sticks.
FOUR! Nicely played. Sune Luus charges down the track to this full ball. She gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Nadine de Klerk now rotates the strike as she pulls it to deep mid-wicket.
Short again, down leg. Luus swivels and whips it to deep square leg for a single.
SIX! BANG! Incredible shot. A short ball, on middle. Nadine de Klerk stands tall and launches it over the mid-wicket fence.
It is a length ball, angled in around middle. Nadine de Klerk tries to go downtown but fails to get any contact.
Schutt goes full and on off. Luus taps it to cover for one.
Short one, on off. Nadine de Klerk pulls it to the leg side for one.
Back of a length, in the channel. Nadine de Klerk goes back and tries to cut it away. Gets no bat on ball though.
Full length and on off. Luus drills it down to long on and rotates the strike.
Floated and full, around off. Nadine de Klerk hangs back and blocks it out.
On off, defended to point.
GIves it some air this time, full and on off. Nadine de Klerk dances down the track and swings hard at it but gets beaten by the sharp away turn. Beth Mooney parries it away.
Floated and full, on off. Nadine de Klerk smacks it down to wide long on. The batters take two more.
TWO WIDES! This is slower, down leg. Nadine de Klerk fails to pick it up and so does the keeper. The batters sneak a single.
Nadine de Klerk gets down on one knee to this full ball and sweeps it towards wide long on. The collect a brace before long on comes across.
Flatter and on off. Nadine de Klerk stays back and taps it out.
Length and on off. Luus gets it back to the bowler.
Full, on middle. Nadine de Klerk gets a single now as she knocks it down the park.
Nadine de Klerk walks in.

OUT! BOWLED! Megan Schutt gets herself into the wicket's column. A peach of a delivery to get rid of Delmi Tucker. Schutt fires in a yorker, on leg stump. Delmi Tucker moves back and tries to jam it out but misses. The ball hits her on the pads and goes onto rattle the sticks.
Goes full and on off. Luus makes some room and drives it past mid off. They take one before the fielder cuts it out.
Schutt pitches it up, on off. Tucker gets low and slogs it to deep mid-wicket. It meets the fielder on a bounce. They only get a single.
A length ball, on the pads. Luus goes back and flicks it towards mid-wicket. The bowler gives it a chase and keeps it down to a single.
Flatter and on middle. Luus flicks it square on the leg side and retains the strike.
Luus charges down the wicket. Gardner sees the movement and pulls the length back a touch. Sune Luus blocks it out awkwardly.
An appeal for lbw but turned down! It is floated and full, outside off. It turns in off the deck. Sune Luus goes for the sweep but takes a blow on her elbow.
Goes full, on leg stump. Luus gets low and drags her sweep to short fine.
Tossed up, full and on off. Luus prods and paddles it down to fine leg. They run two this time.
On the pads, nudged to the leg side for a single.
Back of a length, going down leg. Tucker swivels and pulls it down to fine leg for one.
This short ball is pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
A cross-seam delivery, on off. It bounces off the deck. Delmi Tucker sways back and guides this down to third man off the outer half. One run.
Leg bye! It is full, tailing into the pads. Sune Luus tries to flick but ends up playing all around it. They collect one more leg bye.
LEG BYE! Full, drifting down leg. Tucker misses her flick. The batters cross for a leg bye.

Back of a length, outside off. Luus frees her arms and cuts it hard. The ball flies off the toe-end to the right of backward point. The fielder there dives to her right but fails to pouch it. The batters sneak a single.
Bit short and on middle. Delmi Tucker pulls it to short mid-wicket. A tidy over comes to an end.
Goes full and on off. Luus hangs back and works it towards cover. One more run taken.
Full and on off. Tucker mistimes her drive to the left of mid off. They cross.
Floats it up, around off. It grips and turns away sharply. Tucker looks to chase it but misses.
Tossed up, full and on middle. Luus comes down and knocks it to long on. One more.
A single now as this full ball is played to mid on.
Fuller and on off. Luus is not left with much room. Defended away.
On off, defended to point.
Short again, with some width on offer. Sune Luus smacks it over backward point and collects a brace.
Back of a length, outside off. Delmi Tucker hangs back and plays it towards third man. One taken.
Good length, in the channel. It climbs off the deck. Tucker looks to chase it but misses.
WIDE! This is full, sliding down leg. The umpire signals a wide.
A single now as this is pushed to the off side.
Short and outside off. Tucker eases it to point.

OUT! CAUGHT! South Africa Women are falling like pack of cards here. It is a full toss, on off. Chloe Tryon charges down the wicket and whips it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. Alana King takes a sharp catch. Australia Women are right back on top here.
Commentary.Howout: c Alana King b Georgia Wareham

Commentary.Commentary: On middle and leg, Tryon nudges it to the leg side.
Full and on off. Luus smacks it to sweeper cover for a single.
This has been a solid recovery by Australia Women since the drinks break.
On the pads, tucked to square leg for a single.

OUT! TIMBER! Georgia Wareham strikes instantly. Tazmin Brits has to walk back now. Australia Women will be delighted with this wicket. It is looped up, full and on leg. Brits exposes all her stumps as she shuffles a long way across. She swivels and tries to pull it down to fine leg but misses. The ball goes through to rattle the leg pole. Chloe Tryon walks in next.
FIVE WIDES! Georgia Wareham starts with a loosener. It is looped up, full, sliding down leg. Tazmin Brits fails to pull it away. The ball runs down to the fine leg fence.
Brown goes full, angled in on off. Luus blocks it on her front foot. A wicket-taking over by Brown comes to an end.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Marizanne Kapp trudges back on a 2-ball duck. It is full, on off. This one lands and nips away off the deck. Marizanne Kapp tries to smack it through the line but only manages to get a faint edge on it. Beth Mooney takes a sharp catch to her right behind the sticks. Sune Luus is the new batter in.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Darcie Brown

Commentary.Commentary: A single now as this is smacked down the ground.
FOUR! Top shot! Tazmin Brits is on fire here. It is a short ball, on off. Tazmin Brits stands tall and heaves it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
An inswinger, full and outside off. Brits helps it out to the off side.
Full length, on off. Brits blocks it back to the bowler.

Drinks break! The South African opening pair has certainly laid a solid platform at the top. Although they could not remain unscathed at the halfway mark here with Laura Wolvaardt slipping out. Tazmin Brits though is looking in good touch here. Australia Women would hope to take wickets at regular intervals.
On a length and on off, Marizanne Kapp punches it but finds the fielder at mid off.
Slower one on middle, Tazmin Brits tucks it to square leg for one.
Shorter and on off, Tazmin Brits tries to pull it but misses.
SIX! All the way. Brilliant from Tazmin Brits. Slower one on off, Tazmin Brits heaves it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
FOUR! Beautifully timed. Fuller and on off, Tazmin Brits stands tall and lofts it over mid off for a boundary!
Slightly shorter and on off, Tazmin Brits looks to pull it but gets a bottom edge as the ball bounces back towards the bowler.
Marizanne Kapp comes in at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! The partnership is finally broken. Slightly shorter and on off, Laura Wolvaardt looks to slap it but misses and gets the slightest of the edge. It goes behind the sticks and Beth Mooney gloves it comfortably. Laura Wolvaardt walks back into the shed.
Commentary.Howout: c Beth Mooney b Ellyse Perry

Commentary.Commentary: Lands it on off, Laura Wolvaardt flicks it but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Fine shot. A low full toss, on off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it past covers for a boundary.
Slightly shorter and on off, Tazmin Brits pulls it to deep square leg for one.
Bowls it slower and on middle, Tazmin Brits taps it to the cover fielder.
Bowls it full and on off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it to covers for one.
Bowls it on off, it turns away, Tazmin Brits slaps it but finds the fielder at point.
Fuller and on middle, Laura Wolvaardt taps it to mid off for one.
Another fuller one, on off, Tazmin Brits flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Bowls it fuller and on middle, Tazmin Brits moves forward and drills it through mid on for a boundary!
Fuller and on off, Tazmin Brits blocks it back.
Fuller and on middle, Tazmin Brits flicks it but finds the fielder at mid-wicket.
Fuller and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt looks to play at it but edges it to the fielder at short third man. Ends with a dot ball.
On a length, angling in, and some extra bounce, Laura Wolvaardt looks to play at it but misses and gets rapped on her pads. A loud appeal but turned down. They decide not to review it.
Back of a length and on off, Laura Wolvaardt cuts it towards the point fielder.
Dropped! Slightly shorter and on off, Laura Wolvaardt pulls it. It carries towards the fielder at mid-wicket who shells it.
Fuller and on off, Laura Wolvaardt defends it back.
Touch fuller and on off, Tazmin Brits tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowlers end but misses.
A full toss, on off, Tazmin Brits drills it to long on for one.
FOUR! Excellent timing. Slightly shorter and on off, Tazmin Brits rocks back and tucks it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Flighted up, on off, Laura Wolvaardt pulls it to mid-wicket for one again.
Slightly shorter and on off, Tazmin Brits punches it to long on for one.
Lands it on middle, Tazmin Brits pulls it towards deep backward square leg for a brace.
FOUR! A welcome boundary for Ashleigh Gardner. Fuller and on off, Tazmin Brits moves forward and lofts it over mid on for a boundary!
FOUR! Fine shot. Fuller and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt hangs back and drives it past covers for a boundary!
On a length and just outside off, Tazmin Brits tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Another one down leg, Tazmin Brits misses her flick and gets rapped on her pads again.
Lands it down leg, Tazmin Brits looks to play at it but gets rapped on her pads. Dot.
Too full, on middle and leg, Laura Wolvaardt flicks it to mid-wicket for one.
Fuller one, on off, Laura Wolvaardt drives it but finds the fielder at covers.
Lands it just outside off, Tazmin Brits blocks it back.
Bowls it on off, Tazmin Brits digs it to deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! Lands it just outside off, Tazmin Brits looks to drive it but gets a thick outside edge as the ball passes through the woman at slips, and races away the fence.
Shorter and on off, Tazmin Brits pulls it to deep square leg for a brace. Good fielding in the deep.
Wide! Bowls it wide outside off, Tazmin Brits offers no stroke.
On a length and on off, Tazmin Brits looks to push it but doesn't connect well as the ball bounces off the deck. Dot again.
Fuller and on off, Tazmin Brits drills it down the ground as the ball hits the stumps at the bowlers end. Unlucky for Tazmin Brits.
Good length and outside off, shaping away, Laura Wolvaardt tries to slap it but gets beaten.
On a hard length and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt looks to slap it but misses.
Lands it outside off, Laura Wolvaardt slaps it but finds the woman at point.
Good length and on off, Tazmin Brits looks to push it but edges it towards third man for one.
Bowls it just outside off, shaping away, Tazmin Brits looks to play at it but gets beaten.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt guides it towards backward point for one.
Slightly shorter and on leg, it shapes in further, Tazmin Brits looks to play at it but gets rapped on her pads as the ball bounces off the deck.
On a hard length and on off, Tazmin Brits eases it to short covers.
Bowls it outside off, shaping away, Laura Wolvaardt looks to drive it but edges it to third man for one.
Fuller and outside off, Laura Wolvaardt looks to play at it but misses.
Fuller again, just outside off, Laura Wolvaardt eases it to mid off.
Too full, outside off, shaping away, Laura Wolvaardt looks to play at it but misses.
Darcie Brown to share the new ball.
Lands it on off, Laura Wolvaardt tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
On a length and on off, Laura Wolvaardt defends it solidly.
On a length, angling in, Laura Wolvaardt looks to play at it but gets an inside edge onto her pads.
FOUR! What a shot. Shorter and some width to offer, Laura Wolvaardt hangs back and slaps it past backward point for a boundary!
On a length and on off, Laura Wolvaardt blocks it back towards the bowler.

FOUR LEG BYES! Not the start Australia Women wanted. Lands it down leg again, Laura Wolvaardt misses her flick and the ball brushes her thighs. The keeper fails to grab it as it races away from the fine leg fence for a boundary!
Wide! Starts with a length ball down leg, Laura Wolvaardt misses her flick.

Right then, we are done with the pre-match proceedings. Both teams make their way in the middle. Laura Wolvaardt and Tazmin Brits walk in with their blades for South Africa Women. Megan Schutt to start with the new ball. Here we go...

We are a few minutes away from the start of the game as both teams stride out in the middle and line up for their respective national anthems. It will be Australia's first, followed by the national anthem of South Africa.

Australia Women (Playing XI) - Beth Mooney (WK), Meg Lanning (C), Ashleigh Gardner, Ellyse Perry, Tahlia McGrath, Grace Harris, Annabel Sutherland (In for Alyssa Healy), Georgia Wareham, Alana King, Megan Schutt, Darcie Brown.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Tazmin Brits, Laura Wolvaardt, Marizanne Kapp, Sune Luus (C), Chloe Tryon, Nadine de Klerk, Delmi Tucker, Sinalo Jafta (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Masabata Klaas (In for Ayabonga Khaka), Nonkululeko Mlaba.
TOSS - Australia Women win the toss and they will BOWL first.

The result of the previous game just came out and it is England Women that continue their winning run in this tournament. They beat India Women by 11 runs to take the top spot in Group B. Australia Women and England Women are the only two sides in this campign who are yet to suffer a defeat.

South Africa Women lost their first game against Sri Lanka Women but bounced back and thrashed New Zealand Women in their second game. They won the game by a margin of 65 runs and will look to carry on with the momentum. Sune Luus will be hoping to win this game and claw their way up in the points table. Can they pull up a shocker against the mighty Aussies? Let's find out. Toss and team news to follow shortly...

Hello, and a warm welcome to the 15th game of the ICC Womens T20 World Cup as South Africa Women take on the Australia Women at St George's Park, Gqeberha. The Australia Women are well dominating the league and are well-settled on the top of the table. They have won all their three games comprehensively and will look to continue with the same momentum.
... MATCH DAY ...

Australia Women will play their last group stage match against South Africa at St George's Park. A win in this game will seal their place into the semi-finals. They are in solid form and it looks highly likely that they would finish at the top. Alyssa Healy continues her good form at the top with her second fifty in three matches and her opening partner Beth Mooney has also looked to have found her rhythm. The lead pacer in the Australian camp, Megan Schutt is also in her best form and that is great news for Australia Women's team. The likes of Darcie Brown, Gardner, and Wareham have also made significant contributions with the ball. On the other hand, Sune Luus will be hopeful after a brilliant win over the New Zealand Women. They will be hoping to carry on with the momentum and claw their way up the points table. Like the opposition, South Africa Women also has a good number of all-rounders in the squad, and that should give them the required power to go against the mighty Aussies. Can they do it? Or will the Aussies continue their dominance in the league? Let's find out together.
